ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels, with high-intensity pixels restricted to water droplets and distal tip colonization.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity black field covering >95% of the visible surface; discrete high-contrast beige/white clusters localized exclusively at the distal left and right lobe extremities.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 45 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/6th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across 100% of the visible trailing edge, characterized by irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly concave curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes, representing barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; presence of several circular 'cookie-cutter' style scars on the medial-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple pinniped heads (seals or sea lions) in the immediate foreground water surrounding the fluke's insertion point.
